tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and page ground. The desktop sidebar sits on a mix of surface-2 and surface; the mobile screen uses surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content panes: the desktop list pane, the mobile screen, sheets, the composer card.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Secondary fills: default buttons, kbd hints, the sheet grabber, sidebar hover.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: pane dividers, tab bar top border, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and task titles, on bg, surface and surface-2 (15.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: task meta, dates, counts, captions, unchecked checkbox ring. On bg, surface, surface-2 (4.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cobalt. The one action colour: primary button, checked checkbox, active nav item, focus ring, tags. As text on bg, surface, surface-2 (5.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label, checkbox tick, FAB icon). 8.1:1 light, 7.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: tags, the sidebar's active-item indicator, row hover, the add flash on a new row.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Due soon and overdue dates only. As text on bg, surface, surface-2 (5.0:1 or more).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors, invalid input borders, and the Delete forever fill in Empty Trash. As text on bg, surface, surface-2 (5.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (the Delete forever button). 6.6:1 light, 8.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind an open sheet.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Adwaita Sans", Cantarell, "Noto Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "Roboto Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Noto Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Mobile view title on iOS and Android (Today, Kitchen renovation).

styles.name: view-title
styles.usage: Desktop view title above the task list (macOS, Windows, Linux).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Task titles, nav items, inputs, buttons.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Task meta, dates, field labels, toasts, group headers (600).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase sidebar section labels and badge counts.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Mobile tab bar labels under the icon (iOS and Android).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags, written as they appear in the Markdown file; kbd hints.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge and meta gaps, icon-to-label in tight rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons, sidebar padding, nav icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Task row horizontal padding and checkbox-to-title gap; composer padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side margins, list gutters, group header top.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop view header padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, list bottom padding, section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, focus outline corners, kbd.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, task rows, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Composer card, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the mobile bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, the checkbox circle, the FAB.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and the find box.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Raised: the open composer, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Floating: sheets, windows.

tokens.name: size-check
tokens.usage: Checkbox diameter; also the hit target's visual core (row padding makes it 40px+).

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on touch screens: task rows, tabs, the back button. Meets Android's 48dp and iOS's 44pt.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: Mobile floating add button.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and nav items; 24px in the mobile tab bar.
